description: Unofficial Gummigoo fan-art animated companion inspired by The Amazing Digital Circus. A slim smooth-drawn yellow-and-green crocodile with pale jaw and chest, brown hat and one tapering tail performs original foam-ring balance/catch, two-marker spacing, paper-scrap heel-peel, hat-settling and short-hop motions plus three-direction articulated strides. The dorsal ridge is simplified as one continuous rounded strip, and props are safe foam or paper models. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
